integrity: The all-size proof is self-contained; an exact rational verifier exhausts permutations through size eight and tests algebraic consequences for larger finite sizes. Enumeration is a check, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform permutations only, with absolute position indexing; aggregate record–excedance generating functions are already available in prior literature. An independently established earlier positional formula may exist. No independent audit has been performed.
title: A triangular record–excedance covariance law for uniform permutations
